query:
RETURN $left AS contribution
UNION ALL
RETURN $right AS contribution
NEXT
RETURN sum(contribution) AS total
notes: Database procedure body using the supplied non-null INT64 external parameters exactly as $left and $right. UNION ALL preserves both contributions even when equal; NEXT passes the combined rows to the documented numeric aggregate sum(). References: SKILL.md; references/documented-syntax.md (composite query, RETURN, Database statement block); references/documented-functions.md (sum, Database and Analytics); references/procedure-language.md (query-result NEXT pipeline); references/identifiers.md and checklist.md. The bundled quote-identifiers helper confirmed contribution and total are ordinary identifiers. No database execution performed.
